newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Vacuum to report share change.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Vacuum to report share change.

text.p: Shanghai Vacuum and Electron Devices Co Ltd will report a major restructuring in its state share holdings on Thursday with the aim of improving the firm's performance, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
The restructure would involve a transfer of the company's 237.8391 million state shares to four major shareholders which currently have no stake in the company, the spokesman said.

The four new shareholders include Shanghai Video and Audio Electric (Group) Co, the parent company of Shanghai Video and Audio Electric Co Ltd, a domestic A share company listed in Shanghai, the spokesman said.
Another will be Shanghai Automobile Industrial Corp, he said, but declined to name the other two new shareholders.

The state shares, which make up 44.78 percent of Vacuum and Electron's total 531.0876 million outstanding shares, are currently owned by Shanghai Electric Meters (Group) Co, a subsidiary of the Shanghai city government.
Shanghai Vacuum's main product is television display tubes.
"The shift of ownership to the four shareholders will greatly improve our performance, because they are more closely related to our business," the spokesman said.
